summary: ModuLink Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement of up to 12,500 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $80.00 per share, convertible into 20,000 common shares each. As of the filing, 3,750 shares were sold to three investors for ~$300,000 gross proceeds. The offering was conducted offshore under Regulation S to non-U.S. persons. The transaction is a routine capital raising event with no change of control, special distribution, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved. The filing does not trigger a special-situations category; it is a standard equity financing.
